description: This PHP class defines a model for representing total durations in the OrangeHRM Time plugin API. It encapsulates a duration in seconds and provides a method to convert it into an array suitable for API responses, including hours, minutes, and a formatted label.

classes.name: TotalDurationModel
classes.description: A model class representing total duration, providing formatted data including hours, minutes, and a label derived from the total seconds duration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TotalDurationModel with a duration in seconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the duration into an associative array with hours, minutes, and a formatted label.
